title: Short password minimum length (javascript) — review required
description: A password length floor is set below eight characters: minLengths*:s*[0-7]b. Short minimums let users pick guessable passwords. This lexical rule flags the value; the reviewer confirms policy or raises it.
remediation: Raise the minimum to 12+ characters and check chosen passwords against breach lists.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches small numeric floors; variable-driven floors are missed.
